title: 5 Cents or $1.73 For the Same Gram of Carnitine
description: Of the ten most expensive products per gram in our audit, nine were bottles of 100 capsules or fewer. The cheapest ten were all 150-count or larger, or bulk powder. Shelf price tells you almost nothing. The number that matters is price divided by total grams, and no label prints it. #SupplementSavings #LCarnitine #Supplements #FuelnFitHub
